name: Grade 9 IIIT Practice: November Week 9 - Project Habits
description: Practice words for Grade 9 third-trimester STEM and cybersecurity work.

words.definition: The work and energy put into a task.
words.example: The rubric showed effort because the group kept improving the model.

words.definition: Keeping work clear and easy to find.
words.example: The folder organization made the screenshots and notes easy to find.
Safe use meant carrying tools carefully and keeping cables out of the walkway.

words.definition: Continuing to try when work is difficult.
words.example: Perseverance helped the team keep testing after the first design failed.
The recorder's team role was to update the logbook after each test.

words.definition: A plan for when parts of a project will be built.
words.example: The build schedule set one class for modeling and one class for testing.
